summary.en: Senior JavaScript for Vue and React interviews: array methods, promises, the event loop, scope, and cancellation. Start with section 1.1; interviewers drill the event loop and async/await almost every round.

summary.en: Senior TypeScript is making illegal states unrepresentable: unions, generics you can constrain, and DTOs that cannot send passwordHash. Start with 2.1; interviewers drill discriminated unions and lying fetch helpers.
summary.vi: TypeScript mức senior là làm type không cho phép state sai: union, generic có ràng buộc, và DTO không gửi được passwordHash. Bắt đầu từ 2.1; người phỏng vấn xoáy discriminated union và helper fetch nói dối.

summary.en: Senior CSS is who owns the page: Grid the chrome, Flex the toolbar, min-width 0 on the child that must shrink, and reserve size before load so CLS stays in budget. Start with 3.1–3.3.
summary.vi: CSS mức senior là ai chịu trách nhiệm trang: Grid cho chrome, Flex cho toolbar, min-width 0 trên child phải co, và chừa kích thước trước khi load để CLS nằm trong budget. Bắt đầu từ 3.1–3.3.

summary.en: Where to put work and data in the browser so the UI stays interactive: IndexedDB, workers, service workers, observers, and multi-tab session sync. Quota, serialization, cache poisoning, and update UX are the real interv…
summary.vi: Chỗ đặt việc và data trong browser để UI vẫn tương tác: IndexedDB, worker, service worker, observer, và sync session đa tab. Quota, serialization, cache poisoning, và UX lúc update mới là phần phỏng vấn.

summary.en: Senior Vue 3.5 is compiler-informed UI, reactivity edges, and architecture: hoist versus fetch, provide versus store, client-only. Start with 5.1; interviewers drill patch flags, lost tracking, and SSR fetch.
summary.vi: Vue 3.5 mức senior: UI có compiler gắn hint, góc cạnh reactivity, kiến trúc: hoist khác fetch, provide khác store, client-only. Bắt đầu từ 5.1; người phỏng vấn xoáy patch flag, mất tracking, và fetch SSR.

summary.en: Senior Nuxt 3.x / 4 is a hybrid rendering policy under SEO, auth, TTFB, and server cost — then payload keys, hydration, and Nitro when that policy fails. Start with 6.1–6.3.
summary.vi: Nuxt 3.x / 4 mức senior là policy hybrid rendering dưới SEO, auth, TTFB, và chi phí server. Rồi đến key payload, hydration, và Nitro khi policy đó gãy. Bắt đầu từ 6.1–6.3.

summary.en: Pinia is the Vue 3 default. Vuex is a dialect for legacy interviews. Seniors are graded on where state lives, per-request SSR, and store boundaries — not commit versus dispatch. Start with 7.1–7.3.

summary.en: React 19 is UI = f(state): the function re-runs, then it diffs. Seniors are graded on re-render cost, effects that should not exist, and where data loads — not Hook trivia. Start with 20.1.

summary.en: Senior frontend performance is a measure-first loop: pick a user-visible metric, name the constraint, change one lever, re-measure in the field. Start with 9.1; Core Web Vitals in 2026 are LCP, INP, and CLS.

summary.en: Senior frontend security is a threat model: same-origin XSS, cookie CSRF, leaked client secrets, and npm trust. Start with 10.1–10.3; Vue escaping text is not a security program.

summary.en: Senior a11y is name/role/value, keyboard, and contrast — WCAG 2.2 AA. Native HTML first; ARIA second. Walk a modal: trap, Escape, restore. Axe in CI is not AA. Start with 11.1–11.3.
summary.vi: A11y mức senior là name/role/value, bàn phím, và tương phản — WCAG 2.2 AA. HTML native trước; ARIA sau. Đi một modal: bẫy, Escape, trả focus. Axe trong CI không phải AA. Bắt đầu từ 11.1–11.3.

summary.en: Frontend system design is clarify, then boxes with failures, then cache and rollout — not a folder tree. Start with 16.1, then 16.2 invalidation. Dashboards and marketing hybrids are the two worked shapes.
